body_html:
Let’s Meet Nicole!

I’m Nicole ‘Envision’ Green better known as DJ Dynamic; The Energy Turner.
I am a force to be reckoned with and a producer of motion. I specialize in keeping
the crowd engaged while taking them on a musical journey all throughout the night.
If you like collaborating with a DJ who has a passion for connecting with each audience
on a personal and emotional level; I am your girl.

Nicole joins the JAMMIN’ DJs team from Detroit Michigan! She has experience as a Life coach, motivational speaker, and social media influencer! She loves to create and cultivate memorable moments and experiences.

What’s in Nicole’s Headphones? Old School R&B, Gospel, Hip Hop, Funk, Soul, Rap & Pop.

What are your favorite floor fillers? Poison – Bel Biv Devoe & Girls Just Want to Have Fun – Cyndi Lauper
